statement: A platform or app candidate that removes a policy another document's binding refers to is not published; the back-reference index is added to before a head moves and removed from only after.
guards: control:AppPermissionReferencesTest#a tenant's reference to an app permission is indexed under the app only, every other one as before
control:AppPermissionReferencesTest#the app cannot remove a permission a tenant refers to, and the platform holds no member for it
